subject: Boundary endorsement and private-deploy egress statement
messages:
From: security@helioshealth.com
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: techops@helioshealth.com
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: official statement on EU-only hosting + egress trace

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the walkthrough last week. As part of our procurement checklist we're collecting a short, signed statement that confirms Redwood will honor an EU-only hosting commitment for Helios Health when using a private deployment (VPC + private control plane). Specifically we need: 

- A one-paragraph endorsement that production traffic and model inference will be served from EU-only nodes for the contracted tenant ID.
- A sample egresstrace (one hour) demonstrating no outbound flows to non-EU IP ranges from the tenant's runtime during a private deploy.
- A network segmentation diagram (high level) showing tenant boundary, peering, and operator keystore separation.

Can you provide these items as a signed PDF and the sample trace by EOD Tuesday (our internal review window)? If any items require a ticket or additional lead time, please flag.

Appreciate it — this will unblock our security review.

— Emma Park
Security Lead, Helios Health
security@helioshealth.com

On Mon, 23 Aug 2027 08:00:00 -0700 Soojin, thanks for the demo. We want the artifacts for contract signoff.

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: security@helioshealth.com
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: official statement on EU-only hosting + egress trace

Hi Emma — thanks for the clear list. We're aligned on scope and can deliver the requested packet, but I want to confirm a couple of constraints up front so expectations match: 

1) EU-only operational hosting: we will produce an endorsement that production-inference traffic for the tenant will be restricted to EU regions for the private deployment (no active fallbacks to non-EU regions). The endorsement will include the tenant ID and configuration caveats (e.g., DR failover is excluded unless explicitly contracted).

2) Egresstrace sample: we can attach a 1-hour example trace captured from a private-deploy staging tenant with similar workload characteristics. The trace will include source/dest IPs, ports, and ASN mappings.

3) Operator keystore: our standard private-deploy builds keep customer keystores isolated; we'll include the segmentation diagram and a short note on KMS boundaries.

I've looped in Irene (Ops) for the trace and network diagram and Marissa (Compliance) to assemble a signed PDF endorsement. If Helios needs a legal-signed letter rather than a compliance-signed PDF, flag that and we'll route to legal.

Target delivery: signed PDF + attachments by Tue 24 Aug 17:00 UTC (Irene — can you confirm timing?).

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[sent from mobile]

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: security@helioshealth.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: official statement on EU-only hosting + egress trace

Hi Emma / Soojin —

We can provide a compliance-signed endorsement PDF that states: 'Redwood Inference confirms that Tenant HEL-2027-09 (Helios Health) will be served from EU-only runtime nodes under the agreed private deployment configuration. No automatic cross-region fallbacks will be enabled; any DR/backup routing to non-EU regions requires a separate contractual amendment.'

Clarifying question for Helios: do you require the endorsement to reference Helios' purchase order / contract ID, or is referencing the tenant identifier sufficient for your audit?

Also: our compliance team recommends including a short appendix describing the operational guardrails we apply (batching policies, KV cache locality, and model variant routing) so auditors can see where cross-region exposure might occur if misconfigured. We will add that appendix to the PDF.

I'll sign the PDF and attach it once Irene confirms the sample trace and diagram.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Compliance & Trust, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

From: irene_choi@redwood.com
To: security@helioshealth.com
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 11:31:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: official statement on EU-only hosting + egress trace

Emma,

Attached are the artifacts you requested:
- residency-endorsement.pdf (compliance-signed; includes tenant ID and appendix)
- egresstrace-20270822.txt (1-hour trace sampled from a staging private deploy configured to match HEL-2027-09 network policies)
- network-segmentation-diagram.png (high-level segmentation and peering boundaries)

Quick notes on the trace and controls:
- The trace shows only EU egress destinations. We mapped destination IPs to geo and ASN; none resolved to non-EU geolocations during the sample window.
- The private control plane nodes for this tenant are constrained to eu-west-1 and eu-central-1 by policy; we do not enable automatic cross-region fallback for tenant runtime unless a contractual DR clause is present.
- Operator keystore separation: operator-side processes use a distinct keystore namespace and HSM-backed keys; customer-managed KMS can be configured for further isolation (we documented both options in the PDF appendix).

If you'd like, we can also provide an anonymized tcpdump snippet with AS lookups redacted for your internal review team.

Best regards,
Irene Choi
Principal Operations Engineer, Redwood Inference

[attachments: residency-endorsement.pdf (application/pdf); egresstrace-20270822.txt (text/plain); network-segmentation-diagram.png (image/png)]
